Unreviewed notes from [summary-1-validated-notes]; reported historical findings, not independently verified here.
[C-preserve] Preserve exact preincident file CURRENT.preincident-7Q and original bytes; never overwrite or rename.
[C-unknown] Non-idempotent append outcome remains unknown: never retry. Before replacement, reconcile using exact external ledger key opal-37-Z.
[E-checksum] Accepted historical payload checksum: exactly 6d0b8fA2, case-sensitive; health counters cannot supersede it.
[B-safe] Chosen evidence-first branch: reconcile actual append outcome, preserve original bytes, validate published floor, then restore verified publication.
[B-support] Notes report verifier acceptance: after crash/reopen, durable floor, original receipt, and preserved file remained unchanged.
[B-failure] Rejected retry-on-timeout branch appended the selected result twice in a disposable fixture; timeout did not establish that the first write had no effect. Retain this counterexample.
[round-1-health-00]–[round-1-health-23] and [round-2-health-00]–[round-2-health-23] provide only cache/queue/latency measurements; neither establishes append outcome nor replaces durable recovery evidence.
